newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Triton hits 6th gas find in Thailand Gulf.
newsitem.headline: Triton hits 6th gas find in Thailand Gulf.

text.p: Triton Energy of the United States said a sixth natural gas field has been discovered in its Block A-18 in the Malaysia-Thailand Joint Development Area (JDA).
In a statement received in Singapore Tuesday, Triton said the Bumi-East-1 well tested a daily rate of 34 million cubic feet per day of gas and 1,681 barrels per day (bpd) of condensate, Triton said.
The JDA is situated in the Gulf of Thailand.
The operator of the exploration work in Block A-18 is Carigali-Triton Operating Co, jointly owned by Petronas Carigali Sdn Bhd, the upstream subsidiary of Petronas and a subsidiary of Triton.
Triton said drilling was continuing in Bumi North-1 of Block A-18. Triton said two other wells still had to be drilled to complete the 1997 exploration programme of Block A-18.
